source: User-supplied in-chat screenshots, 24 Sep 2026: Kawa and Ferguson coach previews (per-category 'Avg: X (Q)'), and nine club overview tooltips ('Team OVR for your club level' / 'Total Team Quality value').
userExplanation: The bracketed value is attribute quality. Player quality increases with manager level; in association play player OVR supersedes quality, and the same 180 rule applies at every manager level.

finding.fitClubLevel15: least squares over 7 points: quality = 70.10 + 0.2497 * displayed, max |residual| 0.03 (display rounding and fractional stats)
finding.bracketCarriesNoExtraInformation: At a fixed offset the bracketed quality is a deterministic rescaling of the displayed category mean. The 'target gap' interpretation recorded in STRUCTURE_AUDIT_20260924.md addendum 2 is withdrawn.
finding.implication: At a fixed offset the displayed-unit model and a quality-unit model are identical. If the offset differs between captures (club level or view), every displayed-unit threshold shifts by 4 x the offset difference. Every card and preview must therefore record the club level and the view it was captured in; historic records captured under a different offset are not directly comparable in displayed units.
finding.archiveComparability: The 10-12 Sep archive and the 23-24 Sep captures share club level 15, so they share the displayed-unit scale; no conversion is needed inside the calibration partition.
finding.histNote: An offset change cannot by itself rescue the HIST dose anomaly. Ryan Rodger's OVR 114 (HIST) -> 89 (current) implies either an older, lower offset, which inflates HIST displayed coordinates and makes his low implied dose (0.47) worse, or seasonal decay; the two are not separable from the records.
finding.replication: Ryan Rodger's coach screen (24 Sep, club level 15) reproduces 70 + mean/4 on all three categories (86.0 / 98.6 / 93.0 vs displayed 86.1 / 98.6 / 93).

openQuestions: Club level and offset during the canonical-workbook HISTORICAL_CALIBRATION captures (the quarantined ORDINARY COACH stratum). Unknown; those records stay quarantined for the dose-free reasons already documented.
